entities.summary: Sasykkol is a lake in eastern Kazakhstan. It is located near 46°35′0″N 81°0′0″E. It has a surface area of 600 km2, average depth of 3.3 m, and maximum depth of 4.7 m. Fishery on the lake is common. Water birds including the mute swan, whooper swan, and spoonbill can be found here.
